reviewed_by: Gemini Pro blind reviewer, batch Re-Harden (mat_g2_na_q1_0), 2026-08-18

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The sample items directly fulfill the target competency of counting numbers up to 1000. Problems evaluate forward sequential counting such as "What number comes next when counting: 109, 110, 111, 112, ___?", backward counting like "What number comes next when counting backward: 83, 82, 81, 80, ___?", and skip counting like "What number comes next when counting: 0, 100, 200, 300, ___?". All items directly assess core counting competencies.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The items thoroughly cover multiple aspects of counting within 1000. This includes single-step forward counting across decade and century boundaries ("What number comes next when counting: 148, 149, 150, 151, ___?"), missing number sequences ("Find the missing number: 682, 683, 684, 685, ___" and "Find the missing number: 91, 92, 93, 94, ___"), skip counting by 2s and 100s ("What number comes next when counting: 74, 76, 78, 80, ___?" and "What number comes next when counting: 0, 100, 200, 300, ___?"), verbal/word problem counting ("Moses is counting forward by 1 starting from 52. The count is: 52, 53, 54, 55. What is the next number Moses should say?"), and number line reading ("What number is marked on the number line?").

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The reading load, question framing, and mathematical structures are well-suited for Grade 2 Quarter 1 learners. The phrasing is concise and direct, e.g. "What number comes next when counting: 32, 33, 34, 35, ___?" and "Find the missing number: 91, 92, 93, 94, ___", avoiding unnecessary linguistic complexity.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: A balanced mix of formatters and problem structures is represented, spanning multiple choice ("What number comes next when counting: 545, 546, 547, 548, ___?"), cloze / fill-in-the-blank ("Find the missing number: 682, 683, 684, 685, ___" and "Moses is counting forward by 1 starting from 52. The count is: 52, 53, 54, 55. What is the next number Moses should say?"), and visual number line reading ("What number is marked on the number line?").

competency_alignment.rationale: All generated items are tightly bound to the standard "Count up to 1000.". There is no out-of-scope arithmetic, multidigit operations, or concepts beyond Grade 2 Quarter 1. Items like "What number comes next when counting: 141, 142, 143, 144, ___?" and "What number comes next when counting: 80, 81, 82, 83, ___?" focus purely on counting skills.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Number magnitude strictly adheres to the up-to-1000 range. Samples feature 2-digit numbers ("What number comes next when counting: 62, 63, 64, 65, ___?"), numbers bridging into the hundreds ("What number comes next when counting: 109, 110, 111, 112, ___?"), mid-range 3-digit numbers ("Find the missing number: 682, 683, 684, 685, ___" and "What number comes next when counting: 545, 546, 547, 548, ___?"), and multiples of 100 ("What number comes next when counting: 0, 100, 200, 300, ___?"), none of which exceed 1000.
